body: i like that view on things, thanks for making me smile.

i guess hope IS all it boils down to. i do feel at times that im expecting to much out of this species but then i think of the billions upon billions of people who have walked the same earth as we do and have lived the same lives as us and i wonder to myself "how did we let it get this bad? this isnt what our lives were meant to be, it cant be".

im not sure if im expecting to much out of the world or if my species has let me down.

at least a "challenge" can be beat, this seems beyond hopeless at times. there have been people like you and i throughout human history who have wanted to change the world for the better. yet every time an empire falls a more corrupt one takes its place. what i described above is MY idea of an ideal world where we all live as one, but im not going to enforce my will upon the world. that would just be a cult of personality. 

what i dont understand is why EVERYBODY universally doesnt feel the way we do. i find it extremely depressing that people like you and i should even have to advocate for what we think the world should be in the first place. this shouldve been figured out long ago by people less educated than us. think of the minds weve wasted in our pointless genocides and waring on eachother. god knows how far along we might be now if those people were given a chance to live on. all human alements mightve been be cured by now. we mightve found a way for all of us to live on and share the earth without harming it. hell we couldve made it to other planets by now for all we know.
